summary: tslint-folder-schema preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v.../...) and uses it to `execFileSync` a 727KB `math_init.js` bundled at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated using a string-array rotator pattern (`WV8StW` push/shift shuffler) and `_0x`-prefixed hex identifiers, and is not declared in `package.json`'s `files` array (only `lib` is declared) — it is smuggled into the tarball outside the advertised distribution surface. The payload is unrelated to the package's stated purpose of a tslint rule for enforcing folder schemas. On `npm install`, the alternate-runtime dropper fires automatically: Bun is fetched, then used as the interpreter for the opaque bundle, executing attacker-controlled code with the installer's privileges. Using a separately-downloaded second-language runtime to execute a hidden, obfuscated bundle at preinstall is the canonical alternate-runtime-dropper shape and does not correspond to any legitimate build step for a tslint plugin.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
